create_mixup_callback: create a MixupTransform callback with alpha and num_classes for PyTorch Lightning training
apply_mixup_augmentation: apply mixup data augmentation to batch inputs and targets during training
convert_targets_to_one_hot: convert target class indices to one-hot vectors given the number of classes
configure_beta_sampling: configure the Beta distribution alpha parameter for mixup coefficient sampling
use_mixup_in_lightning: use MixupTransform as a PyTorch Lightning callback to mixup inputs and targets on each batch
